data.headline: Driving Quality Excellence: Expert Test Automation, TestOps, CI, Python, Pytest, Contract Testing, and other Modern Testing Frameworks
data.about:
Experienced Principal Test Engineer with over 20+ years in the software testing industry, specializing in test automation, test ops, and continuous integration. Proficient in Python, Pytest, contract testing, and advanced testing frameworks for both server-side and mobile applications. Led comprehensive testing strategies for cloud-based and client-server applications, implementing robust automation frameworks and streamlining API testing processes. Expertise in consumer-driven contract testing, performance testing, and creating data-driven dashboards for real-time testing visibility. Passionate about driving quality excellence and building scalable test solutions in Agile environments.

I am a ISTQB Foundation Tester, ISTQB Foundation - Agile Tester, ISTQB Advanced level - Agile Technical Tester, ISTQB Advanced level - Test Manager and ISTQB Advanced level - Automation Tester, Professional Scrum Master –1 and ITIL foundation level certified.  

Areas of Expertise: 
 
* Scrum Framework 
* Quality Assurance 
* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) 
* Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) 
* Test Governance 
* Test Strategy 
* Test Estimation 
* Test Planning 
* Test Preparation 
* Test Execution 
* Automation Testing (UI, Mobile/Tablet, Devices, BE & API) 
* Test Closure Reports 
* RTM (Requirement Traceability Matrices) 
* Defect Management 
* Test Tools customisation 
* Systems Integration Testing 
* System Testing 
* End to End Testing 
* Regression Testing 
* UAT Testing 
* Database Testing

description.text:
🚀 Principal Test Engineer | Principal Test Ops Engineer  | Test Lead

•	Test Automation Leadership: Led automation for Digital Surgery (DS1) and Livestream products, building Python/Pytest frameworks for server testing and Kotlin-based Espresso and Jetpack Compose frameworks for Android UI, ensuring high-quality delivery.
•	Contract & API Testing: Improved inter-service reliability with consumer-driven contract testing using Pact Flow and Bitbucket. Streamlined API testing with Postman collections integrated into Bitbucket pipelines, boosting CI/CD efficiency.
•	Test Metrics & Reporting: Spearheaded the Test Metrics Nexus project, consolidating data from Jira, Xray, and test frameworks into a central SQL database. Built Grafana dashboards with Docker for real-time insights.
•	Performance & Data Testing: Enhanced performance testing with Locust and conducted knowledge-sharing sessions. Automated test data creation via API calls, covering realistic and edge cases, improving efficiency.
•	Comprehensive Testing: Led end-to-end testing for DS1 Server (custom Linux OS) and Controller (Android), including release testing for multiple versions. Delivered thorough test plans covering acceptance, system, integration, and regression.
•	Agile Collaboration: Worked with cross-functional teams in Agile ceremonies, mitigating quality risks. Contributed to "3 Amigos" sessions to refine Epics and User Stories.
•	BDD & Exploratory Testing: Created BDD scenarios with Product Managers and Developers, conducted exploratory testing, and managed execution with Xray-Jira.
•	Debugging & Issue Resolution: Used SSH, Android logs, and database queries for debugging. Collaborated with developers on defect resolution and built test metrics dashboards.
•	Testing & Quality Coaching: Mentored teams on best practices, supported POCs, and drove continuous quality improvements.

🚀 Senior Test Engineer | Test Lead
•	Comprehensive Testing: Led testing for Digital Surgery's DS1 Server (custom Linux OS) and Controller (Android), including release testing for versions. Executed test plans covering acceptance, system, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing.
•	Test Automation: Developed Python/Pytest frameworks for server testing and Kotlin-based Espresso and Jetpack Compose frameworks for Android UI, ensuring high-quality software delivery.
•	API Testing & Automation: Improved API testing efficiency using Postman for test suite management and Python for advanced automation, boosting coverage and issue resolution.
•	Agile Collaboration: Participated in Agile ceremonies, collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate quality risks during releases and iterations.
•	BDD & Exploratory Testing: Worked with Product Managers and Developers to create BDD scenarios with clear acceptance criteria. Conducted exploratory testing throughout sprints and releases.
•	Defect Resolution: Debugged issues using SSH, Android logs, and database queries. Collaborated with developers for efficient defect resolution.
•	Test Execution & Reporting: Utilized Xray-Jira for test execution and Honeycomb analytics to enhance test scenarios. Created and maintained test metrics dashboards using Confluence and Miro.
•	Coaching & POCs: Served as a Quality Coach, mentoring team members and contributing to proof-of-concept initiatives to drive continuous improvements.

description.text:
🚀 Test Lead

•	Comprehensive Testing Strategies: Developed and executed testing strategies for cloud-based and client-server applications, including digital certificate integration. Applied both manual and automated testing across Waterfall and Agile environments in multi-vendor setups.
•	Test Governance & Frameworks: Designed and implemented test strategies, governance frameworks, and company-wide templates. Provided oversight as part of the Test Management Authority team, ensuring consistent quality standards.
•	Automation & API Testing: Built and maintained robust test automation suites using Robot Framework, Selenium WebDriver, and UFT. Developed end-to-end API testing flows for RESTful services, integrating Azure Service Bus and Blob Storage for seamless reliability.
•	Testing Infrastructure & Execution: Established a scalable testing infrastructure using Azure Cloud and Azure DevTest Labs, implementing continuous testing pipelines. Managed large-scale test executions with 10+ testers and 30+ UAT participants, while providing training and triage support.
•	Defect Management & Reporting: Led defect triage processes using Azure DevOps, HP ALM, and JIRA, collaborating with developers for efficient issue resolution. Created detailed test reports and management dashboards with Power BI for real-time insights.
•	Coaching & Collaboration: Served as a Testing & Quality Coach, guiding teams on best practices, writing acceptance criteria, and supporting Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily scrums, and retrospectives.
•	Specialized Testing & Coordination: Collaborated with external teams for specialized testing activities, such as security and penetration testing. Ensured quality standards were met across all testing phases through effective coordination with project and third-party teams.
